subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: Should TUI inline image rendering be limited to trusted/managed image payloads, or may tool-result `MEDIA:` text cause host-local absolute image paths to be read by the TUI process?
rationale: The feature is plausible, but the permanent local-file trust boundary and fallback behavior are product/security decisions rather than a mechanical code cleanup.

options.title: Rework around trusted media payloads
options.body: Require the draft or replacement to render only managed media-store paths or already-sanitized image blocks, with tests and live terminal proof for both render and fallback paths.

options.title: Approve host-path rendering explicitly
options.body: Maintainers can accept the broader local-read behavior if they document the trusted-source contract and add focused tests for the approved boundary.

options.title: Pause or close the draft
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and close this stale draft if maintainers do not want to sponsor the security and rebase work now.

recommendation.title: Rework around trusted media payloads
recommendation.body: Require the draft or replacement to render only managed media-store paths or already-sanitized image blocks, with tests and live terminal proof for both render and fallback paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the original TUI rendering surface and the generated-image workflow that makes the feature valuable.
